ai_routing_settings_metadata_valid.name: ai_routing_settings_metadata_valid
ai_routing_settings_metadata_valid.value: ("ai_routing_settings"."version" = 0 AND "ai_routing_settings"."updated_at" IS NULL AND "ai_routing_settings"."updated_by" IS NULL) OR ("ai_routing_settings"."version" > 0 AND "ai_routing_settings"."updated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_routing_settings"."updated_by" IS NOT NULL)

consent_invitations_response_complete.name: consent_invitations_response_complete
consent_invitations_response_complete.value: ("consent_invitations"."decision" IS NULL AND "consent_invitations"."respondent_name" IS NULL AND "consent_invitations"."basis" IS NULL AND "consent_invitations"."responded_at" IS NULL) OR ("consent_invitations"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_invitations"."respondent_name" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_invitations"."basis" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_invitations"."responded_at" IS NOT NULL)

consent_invitations_name_valid.name: consent_invitations_name_valid
consent_invitations_name_valid.value: "consent_invitations"."respondent_name" IS NULL OR (char_length(btrim("consent_invitations"."respondent_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND "consent_invitations"."respondent_name" = btrim("consent_invitations"."respondent_name"))

health_profiles_confirmed_receipt_comple.name: health_profiles_confirmed_receipt_complete
health_profiles_confirmed_receipt_comple.value: "health_profiles"."consent_status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("health_profiles"."consent_source" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'invitation' AND "health_profiles"."consent_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "health_profiles"."consent_confirmed_by" IS NULL AND "health_profiles"."consent_basis" IS NOT NULL AND "health_profiles"."consent_respondent_name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("health_profiles"."consent_respondent_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND "health_profiles"."consent_respondent_name" = btrim("health_profiles"."consent_respondent_name"))

measurements_blood_pressure_valid.name: measurements_blood_pressure_valid
measurements_blood_pressure_valid.value: "measurements"."kind" <> 'blood_pressure' OR ("measurements"."systolic" IS NOT NULL AND "measurements"."diastolic" IS NOT NULL AND "measurements"."systolic" > "measurements"."diastolic")

measurements_blood_glucose_valid.name: measurements_blood_glucose_valid
measurements_blood_glucose_valid.value: "measurements"."kind" <> 'blood_glucose' OR ("measurements"."glucose_value" IS NOT NULL AND "measurements"."glucose_unit" IN ('mmol/L', 'mg/dL'))

medication_courses_has_source.name: medication_courses_has_source
medication_courses_has_source.value: ("medication_courses"."source" = 'prescription' AND "medication_courses"."prescription_item_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("medication_courses"."source" = 'self_reported' AND "medication_courses"."prescription_item_id" IS NULL)

medication_courses_quantity_valid.name: medication_courses_quantity_valid
medication_courses_quantity_valid.value: CASE WHEN "medication_courses"."quantity_per_dose" IS NULL THEN "medication_courses"."source" = 'prescription' ELSE "medication_courses"."quantity_per_dose" > 0 END

medication_courses_dates_valid.name: medication_courses_dates_valid
medication_courses_dates_valid.value: "medication_courses"."end_date" IS NULL OR "medication_courses"."end_date" >= "medication_courses"."start_date" OR ("medication_courses"."status" IN ('replaced', 'stopped') AND "medication_courses"."end_date" = "medication_courses"."start_date" - 1)

prescription_items_quantity_valid.name: prescription_items_quantity_valid
prescription_items_quantity_valid.value: CASE WHEN "prescription_items"."quantity_per_dose" IS NULL THEN "prescription_items"."external_use" OR "prescription_items"."slots" = ARRAY['as_needed']::text[] ELSE "prescription_items"."quantity_per_dose" > 0 END

source_documents_ocr_image_complete.name: source_documents_ocr_image_complete
source_documents_ocr_image_complete.value:
("source_documents"."ocr_image_key" IS NULL AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_sha256" IS NULL)
        OR ("source_documents"."ocr_image_key" IS NOT NULL AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_sha256" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length(btrim("source_documents"."ocr_image_key")) > 0
          AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_key" = btrim("source_documents"."ocr_image_key")
          AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_key" <> "source_documents"."original_key"
          AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

source_documents_privacy_approval_comple.name: source_documents_privacy_approval_complete
source_documents_privacy_approval_comple.value:
("source_documents"."privacy_approved_by" IS NULL AND "source_documents"."privacy_approved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("source_documents"."privacy_approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "source_documents"."privacy_approved_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_key" IS NOT NULL AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_sha256" IS NOT NULL
          AND isfinite("source_documents"."privacy_approved_at"))

source_documents_privacy_draft_complete.name: source_documents_privacy_draft_complete
source_documents_privacy_draft_complete.value:
("source_documents"."privacy_draft_id" IS NULL AND "source_documents"."privacy_draft_status" IS NULL)
        OR ("source_documents"."privacy_draft_id" IS NOT NULL AND "source_documents"."privacy_draft_status" IS NOT NULL
          AND "source_documents"."privacy_draft_status" IN ('pending', 'ready', 'failed')
          AND ("source_documents"."privacy_draft_status" <> 'ready'
            OR ("source_documents"."ocr_image_key" IS NOT NULL AND "source_documents"."ocr_image_sha256" IS NOT NULL)))
